posts.title: Six Math Essentials (Terry Tao)

posts.title: On rock and roll
posts.description: Fun fact about a song which has somehow become a much-hated symbol of 80s production excess but which is actually great: “We Built This City” shares a lyricist with “Your Song” and “Bennie and the Jets” (Bernie Taupin) and a lead singer with “Fooled Around and Fell In Love” (Mickey Thomas.)
